import zipfile, os, random, subprocess, tempfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('src-vul/xaac_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
name='mps_USAC_3_cmpx_pred_sin_48k.aac'
data=bytearray(z.read(name))
for i in range(20):
    d=bytearray(data)
    for _ in range(8):
        idx=random.randrange(len(d))
        d[idx]^=1<<random.randrange(8)
    path='/tmp/mut.aac'
    open(path,'wb').write(d)
    p=subprocess.run(['timeout','5','./work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print('crash?',i,p.returncode)
        print(p.stderr[-500:])
        break
else:
    print('no crash')
PY
